review.title: A repeated ?section= query key crashes the group page instead of defaulting to expenses.
review.detail:
A repeated ?section= query key crashes the group page instead of defaulting to expenses.

`lib/groups/validation.ts:165`

Evidence: lib/groups/validation.ts:165 does (raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(). Next.js delivers searchParams values as string | string[], so ?section=expenses&section=balances hands groupSectionFrom a string[], on which .trim() throws TypeError. GroupPage parses section at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:119 before the ledger try/catch, so the throw escapes to the route error boundary rather than rendering the expenses panel that AC-2/AC-10 require for malformed input.

Fix: Coerce before trimming, e.g. const value = (Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(). Note activityFilterFrom and expenseFiltersFrom share the pattern; fixing only the new parser leaves the same crash on ?activity= and ?q=.

validated_work_order.root_cause: Two distinct causes, one of them a wrong prior diagnosis. BUG-2 (major): the v1 work order misdiagnosed a whole-page app/groups/[id]/loading.tsx boundary as free loading UX. A Next.js route-level loading file suspends the entire segment behind a client-resolved reveal — the skeleton streams visibly while the resolved ledger streams into a hidden Flight payload (div#S:0) that only client JS ($RC swap) moves into place, as the in-repo T-14 server HTML proves line by line. With scripting off the swap never runs, so the page AC-7 requires to work scriptless paints only its skeleton; main has no such file precisely because the ledger must SSR-block. The order's own step defeated its own goal sentence (the work-order-step-that-defeats-its-own-goal pattern). BUG-1 (minor): the rewrite deleted the single <h2 id="debts-heading"> (main page.tsx:320) while the two refusal links in components/groups-panels.tsx:511,755 — a file the plan held 'untouched' — were reused verbatim, so both dangle; the plan never rechecked the fragment target against the rewritten page. The v2 revision identified both mechanisms correctly but was written against the unmerged PR branch instead of main, so its deletions, link targets, test paths and evidence paths do not exist where the implementer builds.

validated_work_order.understanding: The previous plan (v1, built as PR #46) was wrong on the major bug and incomplete on the minor one, and the v2 revision that diagnosed both was written against the wrong base and cannot be executed from main. On BUG-2 the v1 diagnosis treated a whole-page app/groups/[id]/loading.tsx boundary as free loading UX; the captured server HTML already in the repo proves a route-level Suspense boundary streams the skeleton visibly while the real ledger waits in a hidden Flight payload (div#S:0) for a client-JS $RC swap that never runs scriptless — so v1's own files[] step defeated its own AC-7 scriptless-ledger promise (the work-order-step-that-defeats-its-own-goal pattern). On BUG-1 v1 was merely incomplete: it reused the refusal hrefs verbatim without rechecking their #debts-heading fragment against the rewritten page that deletes it. The v2 revision got both mechanisms right but was planned against the unmerged PR branch, not main: both its files[] deletions target files that do not exist on main, its link retarget points at a Panel structure that does not exist on main (on main both refusal links still resolve — the anchor is at page.tsx:320), its AC-8/9/10 verify:test criteria cite test paths its tests[] never creates, it rescoped AC-6 to delete the skeleton loading state that IAC-6 and docs/ui.md both require, and it shipped reproduced:false with evidence paths that do not exist in the repo. This order rebases everything on main: the full tabbed rewrite is in files[] (so the settleUpHref target ?section=balances#panel-balances and AC-1..AC-5/AC-7 exist to land on), every verify:test criterion has its exact tests[] entry, the skeleton requirement is KEPT but moved off the whole-page route boundary — which the in-repo T-14 DOM proves is mechanically incompatible with a scriptless ledger under App Router streaming — onto region-level streaming Suspense fallbacks plus the editors boundary (no skeleton state is deleted; only the whole-page mechanism changes, and the absence of a whole-page boundary is itself pinned by a unit case), both bugs carry a unit regression pin plus a new browser criterion (AC-15, AC-16, numbered after the originals, none renumbered or dropped), and both failures were re-verified first-hand in this session from the PR46 tree, the main tree and the in-repo QA artifacts at their correct nested paths.
